5.constraint: Use this flower-apricot short-sleeve knit henley once only for Spring/Summer Casual Everyday, Resort, Travel, creative Office or a daytime Date. Pair with one controlled straight or tailored bottom in charcoal, cocoa, muted olive, warm navy or medium gray and a cream, tan or brown low-profile shoe; avoid a second pale knit, wide or puddled trousers, bulky footwear or head-to-toe beige.

6.constraint: Use this sauce-purple relaxed long-sleeve sweatshirt once only for cool Spring/Fall Casual Everyday, Campus, Travel, creative work or a restrained daytime Party look. Balance its longer relaxed body with a clean straight bottom in ecru, stone, charcoal, cocoa or dark olive and an off-white, gray or tan low-profile shoe; never add a baggy bottom, another oversized layer, matching purple, a black monotone palette or a chunky sneaker.

rejectionGroups.reason: These lace-up tops use theatrical necklines, asymmetry or long narrow bodies rather than versatile modern Zara-led proportions.
These product-only or hanger-only tops do not prove adult shoulder, torso, sleeve, hem or fabric behavior, and several also show elongated or uncontrolled drop-shoulder proportions.
These plain performance T-shirts are tight and elongated through the torso and add no useful modern styling role beyond already reviewed active basics.

These loose T-shirts, layered tops and tank are generic or excessively oversized. Close variant inspection did not justify another basic identity, and the silhouettes would recreate the loose-top and baggy-bottom problem unless over-constrained.
The product-only polyester trouser has no on-body rise, thigh, taper, hem or movement proof; the rolled cuff image cannot establish a clean modern fit.
The black synthetic jogger is dark, cuff-bunched and visually redundant with stronger accepted active and travel trousers.
These bootcut, flared, wide, novelty-washed or embroidered jeans carry excessive leg volume, shoe pooling, distorted washes, hardware or loud graphics.
The branded compression leggings are a tight base layer rather than a versatile standalone men's outfit bottom.
The striped two-piece tracksuit uses an artificial-looking composite, dated contrast trim and a matching cuffed set rather than a credible modern outerwear identity.
The shiny three-piece suit is explicitly wedding and groomsmen styled, artificial, sequined and outside the non-wedding scope.
These faux or PU leather motorcycle jackets are shiny, dated, over-detailed and repetitive; the product evidence does not support a premium modern layer.
These product-only hooded puffers are repetitive, bulky, synthetic or utility-heavy and lack credible adult fit, movement and proportion proof across their recolors.

qaSummary: 40 identities and all 217 recorded color images rendered; 217 displayed images loaded with zero broken files.
2 accepted with one exact color and variant selected each: a flower-apricot short-sleeve knit henley and a sauce-purple relaxed long-sleeve sweatshirt.
38 rejected after the base pass and close inspection of 16 promising color variants across three identities; every bottom and outerwear product failed.
Every selected identity, source product, variant and image has zero collision with every prior accepted or conditional item.

Rejections include costume lace-up tops, product-only basics without fit proof, redundant oversized tees, tight performance tops, flared and novelty jeans, wedding tailoring, faux leather and repetitive puffers.
